# plebtest.com

> PlebTest is an AI-powered startup idea validation tool. It simulates market conversations using AI customer personas to challenge your assumptions and deliver clear kill/pivot/build verdicts. Built for founders who need honest feedback before they build.

## What PlebTest Does

- Validates startup ideas using AI-simulated customer conversations
- Tests assumptions against realistic customer personas
- Delivers clear verdicts: kill, pivot, or build
- Provides structured feedback on market fit, pricing, and positioning
- No phone calls needed. AI does the customer discovery for you.

## Who It's For

- Solo founders validating ideas before investing time and money
- Indie hackers choosing between multiple project ideas
- Anyone who needs honest market feedback but can't do traditional customer interviews
